frozen_identity.question: Will the upper bound of the target federal funds rate be ≤1.0% at the end of 2026?
frozen_identity.literal_resolution: Resolve to target-range upper bound after Dec 8–9 2026 FOMC statement; absent a December decision by Dec 31 23:59 ET, use then-current upper bound. Round to nearest 25 bp; ties away from zero.

latest_decision_in_captured_sources.fact: FOMC raised target range 25 bp to 3.75–4.00%; upper bound 4.00%.
